query: I'm evaluating an 87‑year‑old man. Among male ICU patients aged 82–92 with cardiogenic shock, stratify first‑24‑hour procedure burden into quintiles and report for each quintile mean procedure count, mean hospital LOS in days, and in‑hospital mortality percentage.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate, row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate ORDER BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate) AS procedure_rank, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate) AS procedure_count, SUM(o.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate) AS total_procedure_amount, AVG(i.los) OVER(PARTITION BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate) AS avg_los, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.order_type, o.order_subtype, o.transaction_type, o.discontinue_of_poe_id, o.statusdescription, o.originalamount, o.originalrate) AS mortality_count FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN procedureevents o ON i.icustay_id = o.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 82 AND 92 AND i.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND o.transaction_type = 'Infusion' AND o.order_type = 'Drug' AND o.order_subtype = 'IV' AND o.discontinue_of_poe_id IS NULL AND o.statusdescription IS NOT NULL AND o.originalamount IS NOT NULL AND o.originalrate IS NOT NULL AND procedure_rank <= 24;
